ADMIN_TAB_LOCATIONS_DESC: Where players rent vehicles, which vehicles of the list they can rent there and for how long.
ADMIN_DELETE_LOCATION_DESC: The point, its blip and its vehicle list go. Vehicles rented there now stay until they are given back or their time ends.
ADMIN_C_LOCATION_DESC: The counter players walk to and where the rented vehicle appears.
ADMIN_H_COORDS: Players rent here (2 m) and give vehicles back around it (return radius in Settings).
ADMIN_H_SPAWN: Where and facing which way the rented vehicle appears; the renter sits in it at once.
ADMIN_H_MINUTES: When it runs out the vehicle disappears and the deposit is kept. 0 = until given back.
ADMIN_C_VEHICLES_DESC: Vehicles of the vehicle list this point rents out; fee and deposit are set in the Vehicles tab.
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Money and plates of every rental.
ADMIN_H_ACCOUNT: The ai-core account the fee and deposit are taken from and the deposit goes back to.
ADMIN_H_PLATE_PREFIX: Up to 4 letters in front of the plate number, so rented vehicles are easy to spot.
ADMIN_H_RETURN_RADIUS: How close to the counter a rented vehicle must be to give it back.
RENTAL_RENTED: Rented: plate {0}. Bring it back within {1} minutes for your deposit.
RENTAL_RENTED_OPEN: Rented: plate {0}. Bring it back here for your deposit.
RENTAL_RETURNED_NO_REFUND: Rental closed. The vehicle was lost, the deposit is kept.
RENTAL_EXPIRED: Your rental time ran out: the vehicle was taken back and the deposit kept.
RENTAL_EMPTY: Nothing to rent here right now.
RENTAL_ERR_FAR: You are too far from the rental point.
RENTAL_ERR_ACTIVE: You already have a rented vehicle.
RENTAL_ERR_GONE: This vehicle cannot be rented right now.
RENTAL_ERR_BLOCKED: Something is parked on the spawn spot.
RENTAL_ERR_MONEY: You cannot pay the fee and deposit.
RENTAL_ERR_BRING: Bring the rented vehicle to the counter first.
ADMIN_TAB_VEHICLES_DESC: Every vehicle that can be rented, with its name, fee and deposit; rental points pick from this list.
ADMIN_DELETE_VEHICLE_DESC: The vehicle leaves the list and every rental point that offered it. Vehicles rented now stay until they are given back or their time ends.
ADMIN_C_VEHICLE_DESC: What players see in the rental menu and what they pay. The fee is paid once, the deposit comes back when the vehicle is returned in time.
ADMIN_H_MODEL: The game's model name of the vehicle (addon vehicles too).
ADMIN_H_VEHICLE_LABEL: The name in the rental menu.
ADMIN_H_FEE: Paid when renting, never given back.
ADMIN_H_DEPOSIT: Paid when renting, given back when the vehicle is returned in time.
